verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a community template gallery: you browse ready-made templates from community creators, pick one and customize it, and can publish your own public templates. The CLI `create` command also offers starter templates, and `eject` can clone an existing app. Other non-blank starting points are documented too: an existing website, a Figma frame, or copying a public site's design. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the template and community gallery experience.
